Quadratic vote pricing resists sybils by making ballots super-linearly expensive.
Flow: a voting haven admits only identities holding a 2.0-unit refundable fraud escrow posted 5 epochs before the ballot. The i-th vote costs i^2 points, so four votes cost 30 while four honest voters pay 4 each. An identity with zero attested output for 10 epochs becomes a relic and loses 50% weight until one live vote.
Cost: a hollow identity cannot vote and forfeits its escrow. Funding N=20 sybils costs 40.0 units and returns at most 12.0, a 28.0-unit loss per cycle.
